passage:
A company showed earbuds that could translate speech quickly. Students imagined traveling anywhere without learning languages.
Their language teacher was less excited. She said translation tools are useful, especially in emergencies, but language is more than word exchange.
She gave an example. A phrase may sound polite in one culture but cold in another. A joke may disappear in translation. A greeting may carry respect that a machine does not fully understand.
The students still liked the earbuds, but they saw their limits.
A translation tool can help people cross a bridge. Learning a language teaches them what the bridge is made of.
